claim_scope: Prospective Stage-2 16-row bounded discovery ground screen only; no confirmation, scale, pruning, training-free control, test, or paper claim.
scientific_objective: Test whether exhaustive family-local evidence acquisition and evidence-bound final resolution can qualify the frozen G5 contract corpus before pruning or reward-guided control is introduced.

population.identity_rule: Use the carrier-prefixed manifest split identity for VerifiedSplit, ExecutionPlan, protocol hashing, and manifest verification. Do not use the selection identity hash.

frozen_components.model: frozen Qwen3-Omni Q4_K_M through the receipt-pinned local llama.cpp API-shaped boundary
contact_preconditions: Land and hash the G6 runtime integration and launcher without changing this roster, protocol, packet limits, or gates.

Produce a zero-contact exact prompt-fit receipt for every FAMILY SCAN request. After all 28 reports for a row seal, measure that row's exact fully rendered RESOLVE request before its first and only RESOLVE contact. Include measured speech and special-token reserves under the 32768-token per-slot ceiling with at least 8192 tokens of headroom.
Bind the receipt-pinned runtime, structured ExecutionPlan, complete manifests, and exposure-ledger amendment to the integrated launcher identities.
Verify the frozen corpus, roster receipt, design authority, family-sweep module, corpus renderer, and all 28 family bundle boundaries before the first contact.

family_scan.purpose: one complete frozen family bundle as reference-only evidence against original speech

bounds.completion_reserve_rule: Every exact fully rendered request reserves its declared completion cap plus measured speech and special tokens. Refuse before contact instead of truncating or reducing completion capacity.

comparator.label: frozen G1 M0 same-roster comparator
comparator.rule: After roster freeze, reuse the sealed G1 M0 outputs by identity filtering only. Do not create new M0 model contacts.

scoring.score_open_rule: Seal every complete 16-row 29-contact trace and final-response manifest before opening gold or the official scorer.

decision_rule.failure: If any gate fails, do not scale to 40, 100, or 1000 rows; do not prune, fit training-free reward-guided control, contact fresh88 or test, or recontact a row. Use sealed mediator analysis only to select a construction-only successor on a new identity-only roster.
decision_rule.pass: Only if every fixed16 gate passes, freeze the corpus, family-scan schema, resolver, runtime budget, and decode settings. Then and only then a separately preregistered disjoint 40-row discovery support gate may be proposed.

prohibitions: No model, scorer, tokenizer, retriever-service, external network, gold, reference transcript, task output, score, reward, test annotation, or future-turn contact is authorized by this contract alone.
Do not use G3, G4, G5, fresh88, test, TFRL, or unexposed surfaces for runtime, tuning, or comparison beyond the sealed G1 M0 identity-filtered comparator.
Do not repair, retry, resend, jitter-test, recontact a row, scale, prune, or fit training-free reward-guided control after a failure.
